title: After the Posting
description:
Hyun-su passed.

That day when he knocked: 'Hyung. I passed.'
Four years. In one room. One path.

{name} pulled up the calculator.
From this room — how many years in?

choices.text: If Hyun-su did it, this is possible too
choices.result_text:
Four years. Held to one thing.
{name}'s five years, three billion — not impossible.

Hyun-su became a small proof. One that stayed.

Hyun-su had one clear target for four years.
{name} is solving something more complicated.

Harder — or just different. Either way: still going.

title: Two Drinks
description:
Another hard day.

Passing the hallway — sound from Room 202. New tenant.

The three days when Hyun-su didn't come out. How {name} brought two drinks from the convenience store and knocked.
His eyes were swollen. Didn't say much. That was enough.

choices.text: That was the right call — it helped him
choices.result_text:
Didn't say much. Just showed up.

Sometimes showing up is the entire thing.
Now {name}'s the one who could use a knock — and knows what it means.

choices.text: Today I'm the one who needs someone to knock
choices.result_text:
Could've used that, right now.

Bought one drink. Drank it alone.

That day, knocking was the right move. Still is.

title: When Are You Getting Out
description:
Still in the goshiwon.

Hyun-su's last question at the noodle place.
'Hyung — when are you getting out of here?'
'...Not sure.'

His laugh. It stayed.

Some days the answer is still 'not sure.'

choices.text: The day will come — believe that
choices.result_text:
Hyun-su made it out in five years.
{name} is still here.

But there'll be a day. When this room is looked back on from the other side.
Wait until then to decide what it meant.

'Not sure.' Still the answer.

His question had weight. Today it's heavier.

But still here means still not quit.
That's the only math that matters right now.

title: Because You Knocked
description:
Hyun-su got placed.

'Hyung, I got a job at an accounting firm.'

A photo: suit, business card.

'Thank you. For knocking that day.'

{name} held the screen for a while.

choices.result_text:
'Will do, hyung haha.'

Five years in Seoul. Some days end like this.

Hyun-su went a different direction. {name} is still here.
Both are still moving. That's enough.

choices.text: Think: I'll get out too — my own way
choices.result_text:
Sent a short reply.

Hyun-su dropped the public service exam, found a new path, and made it.
{name} is still finding.

Still looking. That's not the same as lost.
